hero.title2: Journeys that convert, in two languages.
hero.subtitle: AI agents for guests and shoppers, personalization, analytics and cloud platforms for retailers, malls, hotels and venues.

context.title: The sector today
context.body: Tourism, entertainment and retail are expanding quickly across the Kingdom. Brands serve residents and visitors in Arabic and English, across apps, WhatsApp and in person, and every lost enquiry is lost revenue.

challenges.title: Abandoned journeys
challenges.body: Baskets, bookings and enquiries dropped before completion.

challenges.title: Seasonal peaks
challenges.body: Demand spikes around holidays, events and the tourism season.

challenges.title: Fragmented customer data
challenges.body: Loyalty, booking and sales data in separate systems.

useCases.title: Drop-off recovery
useCases.body: Agents that follow up abandoned baskets and bookings with tailored offers.

useCases.title: Guest concierge
useCases.body: Bilingual answers and bookings for guests on WhatsApp.

useCases.title: Demand forecasting
useCases.body: Plan staffing and inventory for peaks.

useCases.title: Customer 360
useCases.body: One view of each customer across channels.

vision2030.body: A thriving tourism, entertainment and retail economy is a pillar of diversification and quality of life.

seo.title: Technology for Retail & Hospitality | Saudi Arabia
seo.description: Bilingual AI agents, personalization, analytics and cloud platforms for Saudi retailers, malls, hotels and venues that turn enquiries into revenue.
